title: Forty Springs
style_block: warm hand-painted look, soft paper grain, dappled green and turquoise light, clear spring water, tall trees, red-brown earth bank, gentle watercolour edges

characters.name: Bereket (Beki)
characters.look: the oldest and tallest of the three brothers, a lanky 19-year-old with warm brown skin, short curly black hair, athletic build, plain swim shorts

characters.name: Tesahun (Tesfa)
characters.look: the middle brother, a slim 17-year-old with warm brown skin, short black hair, plain swim shorts

characters.name: Abenezer (Abeni)
characters.look: the youngest, a 16-year-old with warm brown skin, short black hair, slightly shorter than the others, plain swim shorts

shots.reason: Say where we are: the spring itself, before anyone appears.
shots.image_prompt: Wide view of a clear turquoise forest spring, a large fallen log lying submerged beneath the clear water and visible through the surface, tall trees on the bank, a red-brown earth clearing, early morning sun through the leaves, no people

motion.prompt: slow gentle push in, ripples moving on the water, leaves stirring in the breeze

shots.reason: Meet the three brothers without needing faces, and say how old they were.
shots.narration: We only ever needed one. I was sixteen, Tesfa was seventeen, Beki was nineteen.
shots.image_prompt: Three teenage brothers walking side by side toward a forest spring, seen from behind, towels over their shoulders, the tallest on the left and the smallest on the right, dappled light

motion.prompt: slow push in on the three walking

shots.reason: The oldest goes first: Beki's jump starts the day.
shots.narration: Beki, the oldest, always jumped first.
shots.image_prompt: The tallest teenage boy mid-air jumping from the bank into a turquoise spring, seen from behind, arms out wide, water waiting below

motion.prompt: the boy leaps and falls toward the water, camera follows gently

shots.reason: The middle brother follows: Tesfa goes second.
shots.image_prompt: A slimmer teenage boy mid-jump over turquoise water, seen from the side at a distance, trees behind him

shots.reason: The youngest goes last: Abeni hesitates at the edge, then leaps.
shots.image_prompt: The smallest teenage boy standing at the edge of the bank, leaning forward about to jump, seen from behind at a distance, turquoise water ahead

motion.prompt: slow push in on the boy at the edge

shots.reason: The tricks from the tree: the acrobatics Abeni remembers.
shots.narration: Then it was flips off the tree, and whatever tricks we could think of.
shots.image_prompt: A teenage boy with warm brown skin doing a flip from a tree branch over the spring, silhouetted against bright green leaves, water drops in the air

motion.prompt: the boy flips off the branch toward the water, camera steady

shots.reason: A close detail of the splashing, to show the joy without a face.
shots.image_prompt: Close detail of a teenage boy's warm brown hands throwing water, bright drops frozen in the air above the turquoise spring, soft blurred trees behind

motion.prompt: slow pull out from the splash

shots.reason: The core feeling: all three together, shouting and laughing.
shots.narration: And all of us shouting. Whoa, whoa, whoa.
shots.image_prompt: Three teenage brothers in chest-deep turquoise water, mouths open shouting and laughing, splashing each other, faces small and softly lit

motion.prompt: the three splash and laugh, slow gentle push in

shots.reason: Time has passed: the empty spring, quiet, to land the longing.
shots.narration: I would give a lot to hear that noise again.
shots.image_prompt: The empty spring at golden light, ripples settling on the turquoise water, the fallen log visible below, long soft shadows, no people

motion.prompt: slow pull out over the quiet water

shots.reason: Closing image: the three sitting together, no words needed.
shots.image_prompt: Three teenage brothers sitting side by side on the bank with their feet in the water, seen from behind, warm evening light

motion.prompt: very slow push in on the three

music.caption: warm gentle acoustic instrumental, soft plucked strings, light hand percussion, airy and playful, nostalgic, no vocals

end_card.text: Made with AI. Painted from memory.
